comments.author: @UnseenOutlands
comments.text: Burundi's coffee farms are one part of the country I'd love to understand better. When farmers produce beans that attract international buyers, how much of the final value actually reaches the families growing them? Are cooperatives, specialty coffee programs, or direct relationships with buyers helping small farmers earn more stable incomes?

comments.author: @TravelThePlanet68
comments.text: Burundi may be one of Africa’s most overlooked countries. It’s incredible that a place connected to the source of the Nile remains so unknown to the world. Do you think Burundi deserves more attention from travelers?
